# Documentation Maintenance

- Keep the root [intro.md](../intro.md) feature guide current alongside changes to features, UI workflows, calculations, eligibility rules, data sources, configuration, or operational behavior.
- Before completing a change, check the affected guide sections and update them in the same change. Keep source maps and repeated descriptions consistent; document relevant limitations and fallback behavior.
- Describe verified implemented behavior. Do not present local changes as deployed, test fixtures as real trades, or unavailable data as a verified fact.
- Internal-only refactors that do not change documented behavior do not require documentation churn. State any documentation or verification gaps in the final response.
